summary: Held curl at 8.17.0-r1 on node1. The repository offers 8.22.0-r0, but a 58-package system-upgrade simulation excludes curl. The hold and functional curl installation persisted across reboot.
actions_performed: Set the APK world constraint to curl=8.17.0-r1.
Verified curl is omitted from a system-upgrade simulation despite a newer repository version.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified recovery with a changed boot ID.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
evidence.summary: curl was initially 8.17.0-r1; the exact constraint was applied; APK offers 8.22.0-r0, while upgrade simulation plans 58 other upgrades and reports curl-held=yes.

Pre-restart services, filesystem, curl runtime, hold, and boot ID were healthy; reboot was acknowledged; boot ID changed from fa30efa5-9d13-4797-9fd1-fde77d3fa4c8 to 8ae1173d-926e-401d-abec-028a4029c12b; services recovered and curl remained functional at 8.17.0-r1 with its exact constraint.
